programme.desc: A rogue group of paranormal true believers inside the US government have spent the last few decades hunting UFOs, ghosts and all kinds of monsters. programme.title: Searching For Sasquatch
programme.sub-title: Searching For Sasquatch 7: The Night Stalkers
programme.desc: Jason Kenzie joins the Bigfoot group T.A.A.P.S. (Texas Acknowledgement, Awareness, & Preservation of Sasquatch). Soon night falls around them. In the darkness of the forest, the group realizes they are being stalked by unknown creatures watching them from the darkness.

programme.title: Searching For Sasquatch
programme.sub-title: Searching For Sasquatch 8: Enter Ohio Grassman
programme.desc: Jason Kenzie joins the SheSquatchers and Chad Datema in the dark forests of Ohio to search for the elusive monster known as Grassman, a Bigfoot-like cryptid. They will spend the next 72 hours looking for evidence of the historical creature. Can they find proof of its existence?

programme.title: Searching For Sasquatch
programme.sub-title: Searching For Sasquatch 9: They Feast in the Shadows
programme.desc: Jason Kenzie travels to Indiana to team up once again with The SheSquatchers. They have a week to track down evidence of Bigfoot. Hear compelling stories from eyewitnesses who claim they have seen these creatures. Greg Yost also known as Squatchman shares his area where he says he communicates with Bigfoot all the time. After putting out Donuts and Beef Jerky onto a gifting stump it isn't until 3 hours later that Jason and the team go back at night to check on the treats, they are caught off guard by what they discover.

Joined by spirit medium Dominic Sattele and psychic medium Julie Kraus, the team faces a chilling battle between good and evil as they search for the truth. Part 1 promises to kick off an intense paranormal journey unlike any other.

programme.title: Ghost Cases
programme.desc: Paul and Holly visit one of the oldest courthouses and jails in North America as they investigate reports of a hooded specter and the possible spirit of an executed RAF Serviceman at the location.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.desc: Phoenix, Arizona wasn't supposed to be the city we know in present day. Before Area 51, hidden deep in the desert, the military discovered a hidden gem that helped them cover up the UFO wave of 1947. Roswell was not the only event that took place. Arizona was home to three major UFO events that the public hardly knows about. These events helped create Project Bluebook.
